edges.notes: WebGL is specified as a browser embedding of OpenGL ES-class APIs (Khronos WebGL materials).
WebGL 1.0/2.0 tracks OpenGL ES 2.0/3.0-class baselines as its normative API substrate (Khronos).
Engines often combine Wasm modules with WebGL contexts for portable graphics in browsers.
Overlapping browser GPU API space; WebGPU is the newer explicit pipeline model (WGSL vs GLSL ES).
